sourceRow.meaningAndReason: Restrict life too severely; a restraint metaphor.

decisionRow.reason: Handcuff a schedule or life is a bespoke restraint metaphor; naturalness against handcuffed by requires review. Provisional editorial decision; independent review remains open.

ownerSenseFinding: 3312 uses figurative transitive handcuff for overrestriction by a plan or rule. 2066 is the noun golden handcuffs for retaining an employee through financial benefits; no same learner decision. Literal restraint also differs.
